title: Silk and Wool
text:
Silk is very smooth. It feels soft on your skin. Silk comes from silkworms, and it is expensive.

Wool is warm and thick. It comes from sheep. In winter, many people wear wool sweaters.

questions.text: How does silk feel on your skin?
Why would someone wear a wool sweater in winter?
Which material would probably be best for a warm winter coat?

vocabulary.definition: flat and even, with no rough parts
easy to press or touch; not hard
having a fairly high temperature that feels comfortable
having a large distance between the two sides

paragraph_translations: İpek çok pürüzsüzdür. Cildinize yumuşak gelir. İpek, ipek böceklerinden elde edilir ve pahalıdır.
Yün sıcak ve kalındır. Koyunlardan gelir. Kışın birçok insan yün kazak giyer.
